Bike or walk for trips under 2 km. It’s often just as fast.
Try one meatless day a week. Beans and lentils are cheap protein.
Unplug chargers when you’re done. They draw power even with nothing attached.
Carry a reusable bottle. Refill stations are everywhere.
Line-dry your clothes when you can. Dryers use a lot of energy.
Compost food scraps instead of binning them.
Take shorter showers: two minutes less saves a lot of hot water.
Turn off lights when you leave a room.
